mission_assessment.rev0695_focus: make suspicious claimed-workorder plan/evidence drift durable as quarantine rather than a rollback-only failure

audit_refactor_target: shared resume-transfer workorder claim/probe/reclaim/abandon helper, terminal work_state schema, and result counters
audit_findings: Rev0694 correctly separated retry readiness from lease expiry, but suspicious claimed-row evidence drift still used a generic exception path.
A daemon needs a durable terminal fact that survives the failing operation, so operators and future repair logic can distinguish ordinary retry exhaustion from unsafe evidence drift.
The row helper was already centralized enough to add quarantine without widening the filesystem mutation surface.

quarantine is distinct from max-claim-attempt abandon
executor skips byte writes when claim/probe quarantines any selected chunk
